experimental_authoritative_replay.description: Dangerous development gate. When enabled with network mode 1/2, local pending commands are removed and only host-authorized COMMIT commands are inserted back into InputScheduler. Can also be overridden with COI_COOP_REPLAY=1.

trace_commands.description: Development option: log each processed player input command. Disable after compatibility testing.

probe_command_serialization.description: Development option: serialize and immediately deserialize each processed input command without executing the clone.

probe_preprocess_passthrough.description: Development option: intercept the pending InputScheduler queue before processing and restore the exact same command objects in the exact same order when authoritative replay is disabled.
